name: Desktop UI Framework

fixed.comparisonFont: SUIT Variable with declared bundled Pretendard fallback

interactionRules.deletion: archive and undo when reversible; explicit target and consequence for irreversible deletion
interactionRules.unsavedChanges: preserve or explicitly resolve on navigation and close
interactionRules.dialogFocus: enter appropriately; wrap Tab; restore focus on close
interactionRules.ime: do not execute commands while composing

shortcuts.Mod+Z: native text undo in editable fields; supported app undo elsewhere

implementation.nativeMapping: map the same semantic tokens and interactions to platform resources
implementation.dataLayer: implemented separately for each real app

changePolicy: update shared tokens, documentation and version together
requiredReview: actual browser zoom and Windows DPI separately
actual Korean glyph font and IME
clipping, overlap and reachable dialog actions
long Korean titles and unbroken file paths
releasePolicy: Every required quality gate needs matching-version evidence. Pending checks block release approval. Static checks and font load alone never certify rendering.
